description.p: Vimivo is a free, privacy-first, offline-first music and video player with native hardware-accelerated playback powered by libmpv.

ul.li: High-fidelity audio playback with equalizer, volume normalization, and continuous queue
Embedded video player with subtitle selection, aspect ratio control, and resume tracking
Local media library indexing with fast search, album/artist projections, and artwork caching
MPRIS 2 D-Bus integration with system media keys and desktop notifications
Zero tracking, zero analytics, zero advertisements
